verdict.rationale: Xero has no llms.txt (probe confirms 404), but it does publish agent-oriented developer docs, including an 'AI Toolkit' page covering OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP Server, LangChain integration, and prompt examples, plus a dedicated MCP server documentation page. This satisfies the 'agent-oriented docs' half of the story but not the llms.txt convention. Missing for 10: an actual llms.txt file, and independent confirmation that agents can successfully consume the AI Toolkit docs as structured input.
